title: Fix map zoom failure in CustomMapView

requirements.summary: Fix the CustomMapView component so that zooming in does not cause the map to fail or crash. Ensure that tile fetching, Web Mercator projection math, marker positioning, and viewport bounds recalculation all remain stable and correct at any zoom level within the allowed min/max range.
acceptanceCriteria: Zooming in via scroll wheel or zoom controls does not cause a blank map, error state, or visual glitch.
Map tiles load correctly and are positioned accurately at all zoom levels.
Member markers remain correctly positioned on the map after zooming in or out.
The auto-fit bounds behavior still works correctly after a zoom interaction.
No JavaScript errors are thrown in the console during zoom operations.
Zoom in and zoom out can be performed multiple times without degradation.

file_operations.description: Fix zoom stability issues in the custom map component. Review and correct: (1) the useMapTransform hook's coordinate sanitization and bounds recalculation logic to handle all zoom levels correctly, (2) the tile calculation logic in useMapTiles to ensure valid tile coordinates at high zoom levels, (3) marker positioning calculations to remain accurate after zoom changes, (4) the auto-fit bounds calculation to work correctly after manual zoom interactions. Ensure that the transform state (pan/zoom) remains consistent and that no coordinate overflow, NaN, or projection errors occur during zoom operations. Verify that tile URLs are generated correctly and that the viewport dimensions are properly accounted for at all zoom levels.

Review and fix the map transform hook's handling of zoom changes. Ensure that: (1) coordinate sanitization does not produce invalid values at high zoom levels, (2) the transform state updates correctly when zoom changes, (3) bounds calculations remain stable across all allowed zoom levels (min to max), (4) drag handlers correctly account for the current zoom level when translating pixel movements to coordinate offsets. Add defensive checks for NaN, Infinity, or out-of-bounds coordinates.

Fix tile calculation logic to handle all zoom levels correctly. Ensure that: (1) tile coordinates are properly clamped to valid ranges for each zoom level (0 to 2^zoom - 1), (2) the number of tiles needed to cover the viewport is calculated correctly at high zoom levels, (3) the lat/lng to pixel conversion remains accurate and does not produce invalid tile indices, (4) tile URLs are generated with valid x, y, and z parameters. Add validation to prevent out-of-range tile requests.
